name: GitHub Repositories must be tagged to clearly identify service, division and directorate.
requirementTitle: GitHub Repositories must be tagged to clearly identify service, division and directorate.
requirementDescription: Naming and labelling on GitHub repositories is important so that in the even of a Cyber incident the right person or team can be found quickly
why: Ensures vulnerabilities and other security incidents can be quickly routed to the correct owner when speed and accuracy is of the essence to prevent a serious cyber incident occurring.
tasks: GitHub Repositories must be tagged to clearly identify service, division and directorate.

actions.description: Repositories must be labelled with the service, division and directorate
